title: Four skateboard presets
change: Q Vehicles now offers real-world oriented Skate-inspired Session-inspired and sandbox-assisted boards plus practice rail and bank
steps: Spawn a board on clear ground. Aim at it and press E. Release controls after mounting then use W push S brake A-D steer and Shift slide. E exits and F4 changes view. T changes stance
expected: Preset label stance speed and riding instructions appear. Boards reuse scene saves undo and duplication
limits: Independent aggregate rider and board prototype. Not calibrated real-world or commercial-game physics. Generic crouched rider has no skate foot IK or dedicated action animations

title: Pop flip catch and manual controls
change: Ground-gated pop and airborne flip or spin use preset catch and landing assistance
steps: Realism and Sandbox use Space load then release. Skate uses the same keyboard route or right stick down then up. Session uses Space load plus Up arrow or right stick down then left stick up. Airborne J-L flips I-K spins and C catches. M-N balances trucks. Hold Ctrl for nollie pitch
expected: No double jump or repeated pop from holding a charge. Failed landing alignment impact or uncaught tricks bail through existing dismount
limits: Partial force-based tricks. No named trick recognition grabs physical rider ragdoll or native timing. Strict presets require deliberate catch and balance. Mouse still controls camera

title: Windows XInput skate controls
change: First connected XInput controller supplies board commands without input injection
steps: A pushes B brakes Y mounts or exits X loads direct presets. Left stick steers except Session uses triggers. Right stick flips except Session uses left stick. RB catches. D-pad up-down controls manuals and left-right spins. LB slides and enables rail support. Try focus loss F7 F8 and disconnect
expected: Blocked gameplay clears pending commands and requires neutral input before rearming
limits: Keyboard fallback remains. No non-XInput adapter remapping vibration controller camera or complete native gesture parser. Controller nollie modifier is not mapped

title: Practice obstacles and lifecycle checks

expected: Supported actions follow accepted reload or melee state while lower-body movement is preserved. Weapon changes cancel old actions

expected: Wheel steering eases instead of snapping. Engine audio follows occupied live vehicles and stops during blocked gameplay or exit
